sentences.en: MADDY: Shall we go through our research for our sustainable fashion project?
sentences.zh: MADDY: 我们来梳理一下可持续时尚项目的调研内容吧？

sentences.en: RYAN: Good idea. I think I've done enough reading now.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 好主意。我觉得我现在已经阅读得差不多了。

sentences.en: MADDY: Me too. I've learnt such a lot about what sustainability actually means.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 我也是。我对‘可持续性’的实际含义了解了很多。

sentences.en: RYAN: Mmm, same for me with ethical fashion. I didn't really appreciate the difference between that and sustainable fashion before doing this research.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 嗯，我对‘道德时尚’也有了类似的认识。在开展这项调研之前，我其实并不太清楚它与可持续时尚之间的区别。

sentences.en: MADDY: I know - most people use these terms interchangeably - but in fact the difference is quite distinct when you think about it. Sustainable relates to the environment and ethical relates more to the way workers or animals are treated.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 我知道——大多数人都是混用这些术语的——但仔细思考后，两者的区别其实相当明确：‘可持续’关乎环境，而‘道德’则更多涉及对工人或动物的对待方式。

sentences.en: RYAN: I totally understand why people get confused, though. There are so many other terms used - like 'eco-friendly', which is actually quite meaningless.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 不过，我完全理解人们为何会混淆。还有太多其他术语被使用——比如‘环保型’（eco-friendly），这个词实际上意义非常模糊。

sentences.en: MADDY: And the way companies use these terms when describing their products doesn't help. They're often deliberately vague. I think. and don't provide enough information about how their products are made.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 而且企业描述自家产品时使用这些术语的方式也无助于厘清概念。它们往往刻意含糊其辞，我认为，也未能充分说明产品是如何生产的。

sentences.en: RYAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 是的。

sentences.en: MADDY: It was interesting to read about the debates surrounding wool production and how ethical and sustainable that is. It's generally considered to be sustainable because it's a natural product.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 阅读有关羊毛生产及其道德性与可持续性的相关争论很有意思。羊毛通常被认为具有可持续性，因为它是天然产物。

sentences.en: RYAN: And it also lasts a long time and can be recycled. All very positive. But I wasn't convinced by the argument that wool production is sustainable because it doesn't use many chemicals - what about all the fungicides and insecticides used in sheep farming?
sentences.zh: RYAN: 而且它耐用性强，还可回收利用，这些都是非常积极的特点。但我并不认同‘羊毛生产是可持续的，因为它使用化学品很少’这一论点——那么绵羊养殖中使用的大量杀菌剂和杀虫剂又该怎么算呢？

sentences.en: MADDY: Good point. And I couldn't find any evidence for the claim about sheep farming being better for the environment than cattle farming.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 说得很好。而且我也找不到任何证据支持‘绵羊养殖比牛养殖对环境更友好’这一说法。

sentences.en: RYAN: No - they're both really bad. I read different reports about how unethical it is to even shear sheep. Some people say it's cruel but as long as the sheep are kept in good condition I can't see anything wrong with it.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 没错——两者其实都对环境极为不利。我还读到一些报告，讨论给绵羊剪毛本身是否不道德。有人认为这是残忍行为，但只要绵羊处于良好饲养状态，我就看不出其中有什么问题。

sentences.en: MADDY: Me neither.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: RYAN: Shall we talk about some of the semi-synthetic new fabrics now?
sentences.zh: RYAN: 接下来我们谈谈一些新型半合成面料吧？

sentences.en: MADDY: OK, let's do that.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 好的，那就开始吧。

sentences.en: RYAN: Let's start with Lyocell, I've been reading about that.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 我们先从莱赛尔（Lyocell）说起，我最近一直在研究这种材料。

sentences.en: MADDY: Yeah, that's the one produced from the pulp of eucalyptus trees, isn't it?
sentences.zh: MADDY: 对，就是那种由桉树浆制成的面料，对吧？

sentences.en: RYAN: Yes, and what happens with that is really impressive. Over 99% of dissolving agents used in the manufacturing process are used again.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 没错，而且它的生产工艺确实令人印象深刻：制造过程中所用溶解剂的99%以上都能被循环再利用。

sentences.en: MADDY: Yeah. Now, there are a few semi-synthetic fabrics that I'd never heard of. Like Cupro, for example.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 是的。现在有一些半合成面料我以前听都没听说过，比如铜氨纤维（Cupro）。

sentences.en: RYAN: Made from byproducts of the cotton industry to create a kind of vegan silk.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 它是由棉产业的副产品制成的，可作为一种纯素丝绸。

sentences.en: MADDY: But I'm not sure how sustainable this really is as there are so many reports of pollution caused by the manufacturing process.
sentences.zh: MADEY: 但我并不确定这实际上是否可持续，因为有很多报告指出其制造过程会造成污染。

sentences.en: RYAN: Mmm. It doesn't compare favourably with all the other sustainable fabrics we've looked at, no.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 嗯。与其他我们考察过的可持续面料相比，它确实不占优势。

sentences.en: MADDY: Bamboo is one fabric we're all familiar with. But I didn't know that it was only organic bamboo that's truly sustainable.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 竹纤维是一种我们都熟悉的面料。但以前我并不知道，只有有机竹纤维才是真正可持续的。

sentences.en: RYAN: Me neither. Apparently. the manufacturing process for a significant proportion of bamboo is chemically quite intensive - which obviously can be quite damaging.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 我也不知道。显然，目前大部分竹纤维的制造过程在化学处理方面强度很高——这显然可能造成相当严重的损害。

sentences.en: MADDY: EcoVero is an example of a semi-synthetic fabric which is becoming really popular.
sentences.zh: MADDY: EcoVero 是一种半合成面料的范例，正变得越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: RYAN: Probably because manufacturing causes 50 percent fewer emissions and takes up half as much energy as conventional fabrics. That saves production costs as well as being better for the environment.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 这可能是因为其制造过程产生的排放量比传统面料减少50%，且能耗仅为传统面料的一半。这不仅有利于环境，还能节省生产成本。

sentences.en: MADDY: That's true. I think demand for cork will continue to grow. It works really well in vegan shoes and bags.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 没错。我认为软木的需求将持续增长。它在纯素鞋类和包袋中表现非常出色。

sentences.en: RYAN: Mmm and it's the only fabric that's fundamentally sustainable - the cork trees it comes from are renewable and the product itself is both recyclable and biodegradable - which is unique.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 嗯，而且它是唯一一种本质上就具备可持续性的面料——其原料软木树本身可再生，而软木产品本身既可回收又可生物降解——这一点十分独特。

sentences.en: MADDY: And the harvesting process is actually good for the trees. There are no downsides to using this source at all.
sentences.zh: MADDY: 而且采收过程实际上对树木有益。使用这种原料完全没有任何缺点。

sentences.en: RYAN: Hemp is another really good sustainable fabric from a natural source.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 麻纤维是另一种来自天然来源的极佳可持续面料。

sentences.en: MADDY: Yes. Did you know that clothes made from hemp protect the wearer from the sun and it's also antibacterial?
sentences.zh: MADDY: 是的。你知道用大麻纤维制成的衣物能保护穿着者免受阳光伤害，同时还具有抗菌性能吗？

sentences.en: RYAN: No. I didn't. But I did read that it's quite hard to grow, so perhaps that"s why it's not as common as you'd think.
sentences.zh: RYAN: 不知道。但我确实读到过，大麻种植难度较大，这或许就是它不像人们预想中那么普及的原因。

sentences.en: I'm sure that'll change.
sentences.zh: 我确信这种情况将会改变。
